note: NOT a pack trigger schema — this is the cohort DEFINITION's end-of-process (close) schema. Register it on cohort_def_id 'ach_exposure_cohort' (New Cohort screen or POST /cohort/definitions). Amendia recognises Pega's process-completed message by matching this schema and closes the cohort by correlation_value. close_correlation_path: case_id; close_outcome_path: outcome. Matches the mock Pega orchestrator's close_payload / scenarios.COHORT_CLOSE_SCHEMA exactly.

event.description: The discriminator the close ingress matches on.

case_id.description: The correlation_value that resolves the cohort instance to close.
